description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper growing and manufacturing trade for the month of March, 2018 will be Rs. 721.40 for normal working day
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper) based on the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector services and administration, specifically addressing service conditions and benefits for workers, which aligns with the Public Service Gazettes category (Type 8).
